message.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>
                    We find classical closed string solutions to the non-relativistic AdS
                    <jats:sub>5</jats:sub>
                    × S
                    <jats:sup>5</jats:sup>
                    string theory which are the analogue of the BMN and GKP solutions for the relativistic theory. We show that non-relativistic AdS
                    <jats:sub>5</jats:sub>
                    × S
                    <jats:sup>5</jats:sup>
                    string theory admits a
                    <jats:inline-formula>
                      <jats:tex-math>
                        
                      </jats:tex-math>
                      <mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline" overflow="scroll">
                        <mml:msub>
                          <mml:mrow>
                            <mml:mi mathvariant="double-struck">Z</mml:mi>
                          </mml:mrow>
                          <mml:mrow>
                            <mml:mn>2</mml:mn>
                          </mml:mrow>
                        </mml:msub>
                      </mml:math>
                    </jats:inline-formula>
                    orbifold symmetry which allows us to impose twisted boundary conditions. Among the solutions in the twisted sector, we find the one around which the semiclassical expansion in arXiv:
                    <jats:ext-link xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" ext-link-type="arxiv" xlink:href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2102.00008" xlink:type="simple">2102.00008</jats:ext-link>
                    takes place.
                  </jats:p>
title:
Classical string solutions in non-relativistic AdS
                    <sub>5</sub>
                    × S
                    <sup>5</sup>
                    : closed and twisted sectors
